items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Now for a while I was in his little group, he had a five-piece group. It was, let's see Larry Ridley, Howard, he played the piano, and myself.

ctx.x: What were some of the places you played in New York? You mentioned the Village Gate

Now here's another thing. Now for a while I was in his little group, he had a five-piece group. It was, let's see Larry Ridley, Howard, he played the piano, and myself. And we travelled. We went to -- I remember a few Universities, I think Rutgers probably was one, and we then we went to Columbus or Cincinnati Ohio or somewhere. And his little group -- I was in it. Now that tells you something. He plays good piano, you know. I give him credit. He plays damn good piano. So, and he had his little group and we'd go…

And I'm in a bad mood, I said, no I don't even want to work -- all this time. And it was a matter that I wanted to, and he never, you know -- and he said -- he called me back, I hung up. I said, man I don't care, I don't want the job -- all this time. Bad as I wanted to. So he called back, and he said, then he said it was an oversight. Now that don't sound right. An oversight -- me? And I said how can you play, get a guitar thing together -- one more time -- $ -- how can you do that without naming me? So he…
